purpose: Keep local RTT policy, remote SDP capability, negotiated T.140, first observed T.140 text, and terminal RTT readiness as separate facts.
claimBoundary: These cases are controlled Baudot readiness-policy tests, not statements about current VRS provider behavior.
Absence of T.140 in one synthetic session is classified as a session fact and is not by itself a provider-conformance finding.
The local-disabled arm is a manipulated negative control, not a claim that RFC 9248 permits an implementation to omit mandatory RTT capability.
rttReady remains false until independently validated non-empty T.140 is observed.
